genxml.title: Dallas DS1744 nonvolatile timekeeping SRAM (32 KiB, byte-wide, with clock)
genxml.from: Analog Devices/Maxim DS1744 nonvolatile timekeeping SRAM datasheet, document 19-5502, revision 6/13
genxml.doc: The 32 KiB battery-backed SRAM with a clock in its top eight bytes. The register contract here covers what the sources state: the clock bytes at the top of the address range and the remaining bytes as RAM. Grades say how each item was derived: established means the manufacturer specification as the source records it, inferred means arithmetic on an established fact. The clock byte order and bit meanings, the reset state and the RAM layout are not stated by the sources and are not listed.

struct.name: RAM
struct.from: Analog Devices/Maxim DS1744 nonvolatile timekeeping SRAM datasheet, document 19-5502, revision 6/13
struct.doc: Battery-backed RAM below the clock bytes. The sources give no layout inside it. The 32,760 is inferred from the clock placement, not stated by a source.

struct.name: CLOCK
struct.from: Analog Devices/Maxim DS1744 nonvolatile timekeeping SRAM datasheet, document 19-5502, revision 6/13
struct.doc: The eight clock and calendar bytes at the top of the chip. The sources give their order and bit meanings only through the chip's own register page, which this import did not read, so each byte is named here by position only.
